description: This file is a React component implementing a login page for a web application. It handles user input for email and password, and on submission, authenticates the user locally by setting an auth flag and navigating to a dashboard. It includes branding with a logo and scoped styles, and makes use of React hooks and react-router functionalities.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React functional component implementing a branded login page with form handling and navigation.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission; sets auth state, saves user info in local storage, and redirects to '/dashboard'.
